title: Enthusiastic and delicious!
text:
We were met by the enthusiastic guide, Jordi, and received expert explanations about their delicious cava. Enjoy tasting and a typical Catalan lunch. Absolutely TOP!!!
We were allowed to bottle our own and even got them to take home😀!
author: Whoknos

title: Hands down one of the best wine experience ever
text: The tour was fantastic, Marti was a really great guide and the place overall has a lovely, chill vibe. The communication with the venue was very smooth and the cava was delightful. Hopefully not our last time :)
author: Anna_D

title: Great time!!! Would...
text: Great time!!! Would definitely do the story again had a fun time with my fiancé learning about wine and tasting it. It was truly worth it.
author: GaryDomond

title: Santiago was an absolute...
text: Santiago was an absolute joy! Very warm welcoming and hands on experience, the pickup from the train station was very easy and they were there waiting for us
author: Lauren_P

title: Cava Delight
text: Martí was a fun and knowledgable host for a really enjoyable tasting and bottling experience.  We will toast our next family event with Artcava cava! Alba from In Out Barcelona arranged our experience - and we think this is the funnest wine tour we have ever done.
author: Louis B

title: We loved the entire...
text: We loved the entire experience, in no small part thanks to our host Santiago. He took care of us from beginning to end. Having grown up in the region where the wine is made, he has a personal connection to the place. He brought local color and intimate knowledge of their process of winemaking. Santiago is a charming and knowledgeable person and was the perfect guide.
author: Danilo_U

title: Best value activity when visiting Barcelona!!!
text: This was such an intimate and fun event. One of the favorite things I have done with visitors to our home in Barcelona. It was a small group. Excellent food  and cava. Highly recommend. We took the train from the arc de triomfe stop to the exit passed Freixenet. Our guide picked us up at the train stop and returned us there as well.
author: ramona_f

title: Fun experience, delicious...
text: Fun experience, delicious Cava, and Marti was a great guide!  The train back to Barcelona was easy thanks to Martí!
author: Jennifer_T

title: A must do adventure!  Great for couples and anyone who loves bubbles 🥂
text:
This experience was by far our favorite of our trip to Barcelona!  Just a short ride from our hotel with a great view of the countryside. 

We were given information about the area and the history of the winery, as well as seeing beautiful scenery. 

Karen is very knowledgeable and was a great teacher in helping us make our own bottle of Cava!  She also prepared a beautiful lunch (extra expense, but so wonderful), and was even able to cater to my husband’s gluten allergy. 

Everything is organic and fresh and wonderful - from all of the cava to the food.
